issues.description: The problem statement (UML and task text) indicates that Animal.messageOnFeed() is a public abstract method (UML shows '+' and the task asks to define messageOnFeed() as abstract). In the provided solution, Animal.messageOnFeed() is declared with protected visibility (protected abstract String messageOnFeed()). This visibility differs from the UML/problem expectation and may confuse students about the intended access level of the abstract method.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the abstract method signature match the UML/problem statement by declaring it public in Animal, i.e. change to: public abstract String messageOnFeed(); Alternatively, update the UML/problem text to indicate protected visibility if protected was intentional.
